data.name: Gate Zero
data.detailed_description:
Step through Gate Zero and journey to first century Judea and Galilee in this story-rich action-adventure that blends exciting combat, immersive exploration, player-driven narrative  and biblical history. In the dystopian future of 2072, the authoritarian regime UniFi controls every piece of information, erasing anything that challenges its version of the truth. When young scavenger Max accidentally activates a mysterious time machine while fleeing UniFi, he is thrust into ancient Israel at the time of Jesus. 

As Max searches for a way home, he experiences a buried history only whispered about in his future. Explore ancient cities, bustling marketplaces, and historic locations. Meet legendary biblical figures, witness pivotal moments firsthand, and uncover the extraordinary lengths UniFi will go to in order to rewrite history. 

To find a way home, you must complete missions, evade capture, explore mysterious realms, solve intricate riddles and uncover profound truths. Survive Roman oppression, battle dark entities that exist in a dimension between future and past, and fight to preserve history’s truth before it's lost forever. Along the way, Max not only confronts the dangers around him, but his own choices that define him. 

Developed with Unreal Engine 5 and crafted with meticulous historical accuracy, Gate Zero immerses players of all ages in the sights, sounds and stories of one of the most pivotal periods in human history.

STORY RICH, ACTION ADVENTURE

Experience an original player-driven narrative that weaves together a dystopian future, biblical history, and cinematic action. As Max uncovers UniFi's plan to erase history, he'll confront not only powerful enemies, but the beliefs and choices that define who he will become. As Max’s story intersects history, experience firsthand the events of first century Judea with Jesus and his band of followers challenging the authorities and traditions of the time.


EMBARK ON A JOURNEY THROUGH TIME 

When a desperate escape sends Max to first-century Judea, he becomes stranded in the ancient world with no clear way home. Complete missions, evade capture, explore mysterious realms, solve intricate riddles and uncover profound truths in a fight to preserve history before it is changed forever


A LAND ON THE BRINK OF UPHEAVAL 

Two historic cultures collide when the storied, ancient Jewish homeland is occupied by the preeminent force of the time – The Roman Empire. Tensions flare as a young rabbi enters an already precarious situation and challenges both forces with his radical new teaching

EXPLORE ANCIENT ISRAEL 

Travel through faithfully re-created New Testament locations, including Capernaum, Cana, Sea of Galilee, Jordan River, Jerusalem, and more.

THE BIBLE FROM A FIRST-HAND PERSPECTIVE

Walk alongside the people who witnessed Jesus' ministry. Explore richly detailed environments inspired by scripture and historical research, experience iconic biblical events, fully immerse in the culture, struggles, and hope of first-century AD through Max's eyes.

data.short_description: Gate Zero is a semi-open world action-adventure game set in ancient Israel that allows the player to explore history and Biblical events. As Max, a teen from a dystopian future, players utilize their own mix of combat, stealth, dialogue, and abilities to save history and get back to their own time.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Dutch, Norwegian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Finnish, Hungarian, Polish, Romanian, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
data.reviews:
“Whether you're a believer, curious, or passionate about historical narratives, Gate Zero deserves your attention. Not only does it dare to explore territory rarely explored by the industry, but it could well pave the way for a new way of telling humanity's great stories in video games.”
Game.Guide

“Sometimes a game comes along that instantly piques your interest, simply because it has such a unique approach that you don't know what to expect. Gate Zero is one of those.”
intheGame

“Gate Zero doesn't simply tell the story, but invites you to experience and defend it, placing the player at the center of a battle for truth that transcends the centuries.”
MondoXbox
